summary: Gallery of 400 hand-picked landing pages, portfolios and SaaS sites across 36 categories.
description: A hand-picked gallery of landing pages, portfolios and SaaS websites — 400 sites in 36 categories — browsable by category with filters and search. A sections page groups live examples by page part (hero, nav, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, footer …) and opens ready-made Figma sections in the uiblockify library; sites can be submitted for review.
